label: One trunk pass, many noise levels
context: Training-time picture. Left: one ground-truth structure (2D chain of 14 beads, dark) and a trunk box that runs once (progress fill, 'expensive: O(N³)'). From the trunk's c, fan out to a grid of 12 small panels (3×4; label 'diffusion batch'): each panel shows the same structure, randomly rotated, with noise at a different σ (σ values drawn from a log-normal: small to large, printed in each panel), and the denoiser's prediction overlaid; each panel shows its loss value. Caption phases: 'run the trunk once per example', 'reuse c for many noised copies (AF3: 48)', 'the denoiser gets 48 training signals for one trunk pass'. Canvas is responsive: width anywhere from 340 to 900 px, height 400 px; derive every size and position from width and height, keep all text at least 11 px and fully inside the canvas, and on narrow widths stack or shrink rather than overlap. Loop forever on a cycle of 10 to 16 s with smooth easing between phases. White background. Put a one-line phase caption at the top centre that changes with the phase. No title inside the canvas (the card has one). Use plain sans-serif labels.

spec.title: One trunk pass, many noise levels
spec.caption: The trunk runs once per example and produces c. Then c is reused for many noised, randomly rotated copies of the same structure, each at its own σ. Every copy has its own denoiser prediction and loss, so one trunk pass gives many training signals (AF3: 48).
